---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible software or configuration problem without private data
title: "[Bug] "
---

## Summary and expected behavior

## Commit and software versions

Python, OS, RadonPy / LAMMPS / MACE / MPI versions as relevant. For GPU issues,
include GPU model, memory and allocated count, not account or host details.

## Stage and minimal reproduction

Planning / preparation / transition / sampling / final verification?
Task ID and SMILES hash may be included. Use synthetic input where possible.

## Actual outcome

Execution error, QC rejection or still running? Include a short sanitized error
excerpt and return code. **Do not attach full logs, site configs, structures,
experimental values, calculated results, credentials or private paths.**
